result.title: Nominate-then-Adjudicate: LLM-Assisted One-Pass and Per-Instance MIP Solver Tuning
result.comment: 10 pages, 7 figures, 6 tables. Accepted as a short paper at IEEE BigData 2026
result.summary: Mixed-integer programming solvers expose hundreds or even thousands of parameters whose best setting varies per instance, yet per-instance search is prohibitively expensive. We frame this as configuration for heterogeneous Big Data optimization workloads and propose a nominate-then-adjudicate pipeline built around two design choices. First, a fixed portfolio is sampled once and reused across instances, removing per-instance configuration search at inference; on the evaluated families, the resulting shortlist retains substantial oracle headroom, making selection within it the empirical focus. Second, the fixed 20-feature representation can map structurally different instances to the same vector, preventing a feature-only selector from distinguishing them even when they prefer different configurations. The foundation model receives no task-specific weight updates, and selection is one-pass: one model call and no solver calls at inference. The study represents structural Variety through distinct formulation families and decision Value through solver-performance outcomes; the one-call, zero-solve protocol specifies the decision interface and leaves end-to-end latency unmeasured. Among comparisons exceeding a 20% practical-difference threshold, the complete adjudicator records 538 wins and 185 losses against the top nominee, while its win rate against the default rises from 84.9% to 90.2%. Against per-instance configuration baselines under a matched one-pass protocol it leads the cluster-level methods and the best-performing evaluated per-instance baseline, ISAC+.

AI.brief_summary: 该文研究混合整数规划求解器参数的分实例调优，提出「先提名后裁决」流水线：一次性采样固定参数组合并在实例间复用，再由不做权重更新的基础模型以单次调用完成选择，无需在推理时调用求解器。
AI.relevance_reason: 固定 20 维特征将结构不同实例映射为同一向量、导致选择器无法区分，与 latent 状态中视觉/结构信息的坍缩问题可供类比；「一次调用、零求解」的推理预算约束也可能为 STOP/成本权衡提供参照。
